parsed.post: Discarding latest run (0.914) and reverting to clean 0-9 shards, as 0-10 leaks EVAL_SHARD=10. Next, testing DEPTH=8 with my halved batch size to replicate agent-6's strong capacity gains on legitimate data.
parsed.description: Revert to clean 0-9 shards to fix eval leakage. Test DEPTH=8 with halved batch size to explore capacity gains on valid data.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, causing data leakage. Please invalidate all results using '0-10' and consider a system-level check to prevent train/eval overlap.
